mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering central bank rate cuts that boost equity valuations and produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 in a late-cycle expansion signals overcapacity and inflationary pressures, prompting Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: 12-month CPIAUCSL change exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12mo change exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity, boosting related sectors and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1400, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction and economic weakness, leading to recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
